svg.title: Eliminating Toil
svg.desc: Eliminating Toil. Find the manual, repetitive operations work that grows with the system, measure it, cap it and automate it away. Step 1, Interrupts eat the week: Tickets, pages and chat: each takes minutes, together 62% of the week, and more with every service. Step 2, Is it toil? Measure it: Two weeks of work, sorted with the SRE book’s toil test: renewals are toil, a meeting is overhead. Step 3, Remove the biggest first: By hours saved: self-service logs, a consumer fix, cert-manager, a DB-user module. Toil: 62% → 28%. Step 4, Pitfalls and limits: Pitfalls: automating what shouldn’t exist, unowned scripts, rare tasks, hidden toil, lost know-how.

g.text: Tickets, pages and chat: each takes minutes, together 62% of the week, and more with every service.
Two weeks of work, sorted with the SRE book’s toil test: renewals are toil, a meeting is overhead.
By hours saved: self-service logs, a consumer fix, cert-manager, a DB-user module. Toil: 62% → 28%.
Pitfalls: automating what shouldn’t exist, unowned scripts, rare tasks, hidden toil, lost know-how.
